title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician
snippet:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician based in Israel.
This is a remote opportunity for a technically skilled AI professional looking to make a tangible impact across business operations.
You will research, implement, and optimize AI, automation, and data-driven technologies across multiple functions.
The role combines AI/ML expertise with systems integration, process automation, analytics, and operational improvement.
You will identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve decision-making, and increase efficiency through technology.
You will work with a diverse range of platforms spanning finance, accounting, labor management, forecasting, and business intelligence.
The position offers a collaborative, cross-functional environment where innovation and practical problem-solving are highly valued.
You will also help teams adopt AI solutions effectively through technical support, training, documentation, and continuous optimization.
Accountabilities
Research, assess, and recommend emerging AI technologies and automation solutions that can create measurable business value.
Deploy and optimize AI models, automation tools, and integrated workflows across different business functions.
Integrate and optimize platforms for invoice automation, receipt management, cash-flow forecasting, labor optimization, bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation.
Connect POS and accounting systems using integration and automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or Omnivore.
Develop and maintain internal AI-powered dashboards using tools such as Power BI or Looker Studio to provide insights into financial, labor, and operational performance.
Streamline financial data flows, including bank transaction imports and accounting processes.
Implement and evaluate reconciliation and intelligent bookkeeping solutions to improve accuracy and efficiency.
Monitor

title: NOC Analyst
snippet:
NOC Analyst | Entry-Level IT Opportunity | Central Israel
Job Description
Looking to take your first step into NOC and IT Operations?
A leading organization in Central Israel is looking for a
NOC Analyst
to join its 24/7 operations team.
The position is open to
technology students as well as candidates with hands-on IT or field technician experience
who want to develop their careers in NOC, infrastructure, and IT operations.
What You'll Do
Monitor IT systems and communication infrastructure in real time
Identify alerts, incidents, and system issues
Perform initial troubleshooting and incident handling
Monitor system availability and operational status
Escalate incidents and work with IT, infrastructure, and communication teams
Document incidents and provide ongoing status updates
Work with monitoring and operational control systems
What We're Looking For
We're looking for candidates who meet
one of these profiles
:
Technology Students
First- or second-year students with at least two years remaining until graduation
Studying Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management, Business Administration with an Information Systems specialization, or a relevant Practical Engineering program
OR
Technical Candidates
Previous hands-on experience as a Field Technician or in a similar technical position
Background in IT systems, networking, or infrastructure
Strong technical and troubleshooting capabilities
Availability
3–4 shifts per week, minimum 90 hours per month
Availability for a 24/7 shift environment, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays
Availability for On-Call / Stand-By when required
Two-year commitment following training
Central Israel | 24/7 Shift Position

key_highlights: התפקיד פתוח ללא ניסיון ומציע סביבה מבצעית דינמית, אך אינו מנצל את השכלתו כהנדסאי מכונות וחשמל.
company_requirements: נכונות לעבודה במשמרות 24/7, ראש גדול, יכולת עבודה עצמאית ובצוות, וכושר תפקוד במצבי לחץ ואירועי חירום.
salary_source_label: הערכת ענף (אין דיווחי שכר פומביים ל-סוויספורט שרותי מטען)
salary_evidence: שכר ממוצע של מוקדני ביטחון ומפעילי חדרי בקרה בנתב"ג נע לרוב סביב 40-50 ש"ח לשעה בסיס, המגיעים ל-8,500 עד 11,000 ש"ח בחודש כולל משמרות.
